title:
ASKING CHRISTIANS
WHAT IT'S LIKE IN ISRAEL 🇮🇱
beats: S43-b hook: Christian Arab police officer at an Old City gate. There are Christian police officers in Israel? Too many.
S42-d Indonesian Christian tourist at the Western Wall: as a Christian you feel safe? Yes, we feel safe.
S30-a STRONGEST: Cesar, Arab Christian on the Tel Aviv beach: you can be free, Arab, Christian... you can be everything
S29-b Arab Christians from Nazareth on the beach: friends that are Jewish? A lot. Muslim? Yes.
S43-e Irish Christian tourist: I am Christian; do you feel safe? Very, yeah.
S36-a END: Elias's restaurant (same man as S29-d): we have Muslims, we have Jewish... we work together, we love each other, we respect each other
